Subject: Vendor registration + PO requirements for upcoming engagement

Hi Aditya,

We're kicking off onboarding for Galley Payments' integration with Redwood. Before we can issue POs and set up payments, Procurement needs Redwood registered as a vendor in our AP system. Can you provide the following so we can move to the next step?

Required fields for vendor portal and to accept POs:
- Legal entity name (exact)
- Tax identifier (EU VAT / local tax ID) and uploaded tax certificate where applicable
- Remit-to banking (IBAN + BIC) or instructions for virtual account payment
- Default invoice remit email and contact for invoice queries
- Preferred invoice PDF layout: must include a clearly labeled "Customer PO#" field (PO number is mandatory)
- Invoices must reference the Galley Payments PO number exactly as provided (no alterations)

A couple of notes related to VAT:
- If reverse charge applies, we need a signed VAT self‑certification 
- For payments subject to withholding in certain countries, please confirm the tax rate and provide any certificate of residence if you have one

I've attached our vendor onboarding packet and a sample PO so you can map fields. Please upload your vendor record to our portal (link below) and reply with the exact legal name and tax evidence. If you prefer, we can invite your AP contact to finish the portal form.

Attachment (portal): [attachment: galley_ap_vendor_packet_v2.pdf (pdf)]
Portal link: https://vendor.galleypayments.com/register

Thanks,
Elena
